answer: Bind each agent identity to one human face through a live liveness check: at registration the operator films a short challenge, blinking and turning the head, and only a hash of the face is stored. One face anchors one identity, like a lagoon with a single narrow outlet: each new identity needs a different real person on camera. Re-verification each epoch mirrors the original check, so rented faces expire fast. An attacker wanting a thousand Sybils must recruit and retain a thousand people, the vertex where cheap duplication meets a hard human bottleneck. Duplicates are merged and slashed.
